description: Welcome to Team 49! I'm a passionate solo innovator participating in the Medchal Local Event for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. My background bridges Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, game development, and interactive tech. I'm currently looking to connect and team up with collaborative, enthusiastic developers, designers, and creatives who want to build an out-of-this-world solution together. Let's create something impactful!
summary:
Got it! Here is the summary without any links:

> **Project Summary**
> Team 49 has developed an interactive and educational application titled Space Mission Design Game, crafted for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. This project addresses the core challenge by empowering users to simulate key astronomical and engineering decisions involved in planning a space mission, fostering a deeper understanding of orbital mechanics and resource management. By combining engaging gameplay with accessible data visualization, our solution makes complex space exploration concepts intuitive and exciting for students and space enthusiasts alike. The project was built using modern web development tools and integrates open-source scientific resources to deliver an immersive learning experience.
